abbrev KF : K := KT [] [] [] [1] [(1, 7)]
def n6a : S3 := write3Eff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, some 0, 0)]) [1]
example : Write3Step 1 [1] (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, some 0, 0)]) (.ok n6a) := .ok (by decide)
example : FreeStep KF 1 7 n6a (.ok (freeEff n6a 1)) := .ok (by decide)
example : EndUseStep KF 0 (freeEff n6a 1) (.ok (endUseEff (freeEff n6a 1) 0)) := .ok (by decide)
example : FreeStep KF 1 7 (deriveEff n6a 1 1 .observe) .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : FreeStep KF 1 8 n6a .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : FreeStep (KT [0] [] [] [1] [(2, 7)]) 2 7 c6b.1 .reject := .reject (by decide)

/-- `endUse` of a value whose owned storage was not freed (expected: `ok`, reported as a leak):
the storage is logically dead and not freed. -/
example : EndUseStep KF 0 n6a (.ok (endUseEff n6a 0)) := .ok (by decide)
example : (endUseEff n6a 0).dead 1 = true ∧ (endUseEff n6a 0).freed 1 = false := by decide

/-- Two incompatible ordinary `Modify` authorities on a `SharedMutable` leaf (expected: reject);
two observations and a `writeShared` within the contract (expected: `ok`). -/
example : DeriveStep 0 0 .modify (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify) .reject :=
  .reject (by decide)
example : WriteSharedStep KA 1 [0] c1c (.ok (write3Eff c1c [0])) := .ok (by decide)
example : WriteSharedStep K0 1 [0] c1c .reject := .reject (by decide)

/-- Return of a value anchored on a derivation of a derivation of a parameter (expected: `ok`).
Callee of case 8: 5 derived from parameter 2, 6 derived from 5; the value depends on 6. -/
def n9a : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff c8c 2 0 .observe) 5 0 .observe
def n9b : S3 := transferEff (dependEff (write3Eff n9a [2]) 2 6) 2 1
example : DeriveStep 5 0 .observe (deriveEff c8c 2 0 .observe) (.ok n9a) := .ok (by decide)
example : TransferStep K0 2 1 (dependEff (write3Eff n9a [2]) 2 6) (.ok n9b) := .ok (by decide)
example : ExitStep n9b (.ok (exitEff n9b)) := .ok (by decide)
example : (exitEff n9b).D 1 = [0] := by decide

/-- Return of a value anchored on a local of the callee through two derivations (expected:
reject). Callee of case 10: 4 derived from the root of the local, 5 derived from 4. -/
def n9c : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff c10a 2 1 .observe) 4 1 .observe
def n9d : S3 := transferEff (dependEff (write3Eff n9c [2]) 2 5) 2 0
example : TransferStep K0 2 0 (dependEff (write3Eff n9c [2]) 2 5) (.ok n9d) := .ok (by decide)
example : ExitStep n9d .reject := .reject (by decide)

/-- `issue` on a full arena (expected: `fail`, state unchanged): both regions issued, both
blocks ended, no `reset`. -/
def n10a : S3 := endUseEff (endUseEff c6c.1 4) 5
example : EndUseStep KA 4 c6c.1 (.ok (endUseEff c6c.1 4)) := .ok (by decide)
example : EndUseStep KA 5 (endUseEff c6c.1 4) (.ok n10a) := .ok (by decide)
example : IssueStep KA c6c.2 0 [2] 4 n10a (.fail n10a c6c.2) := .fail (by decide) (by decide)

/-- Pinning (A8): a value with an in-place pinned leaf cannot be transferred (case 13); a value
whose only owned storage is pinned can; `endUse` on a pinned leaf without `ExternalDone` is
rejected. -/
def n11a : S3 := write3Eff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, some 0, 0), (none, none, 0)]) [0]
example : PinStep 1 n11a (.ok (pinEff n11a 1 true)) := .ok (by decide)
example : TransferStep K0 0 2 (pinEff n11a 1 true) (.ok (transferEff (pinEff n11a 1 true) 0 2)) :=
  .ok (by decide)
example : EndUseStep K0 0 (pinEff c13a 0 true) .reject := .reject (by decide)

/-! ## Findings cited by the report -/

/-- Contracts declaring every pair of regions disjoint, without the obligation `DDSound`. -/
def KDD : K := ⟨fun _ _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => False, fun _ _ _ => False, fun _ => False,
  fun _ => False, fun _ _ => False⟩
instance : ∀ r r', Decidable (KDD.DeclaredDisjoint r r') := fun _ _ => instDecidableTrue

/-- Without the obligation `DDSound` (MM-03.3.8), `split` (MM-03.3 §3, O2) accepts two overlapping
regions and breaks I1: the hypothesis of `split_preserves_underDD` is needed. -/
theorem split_unsound_without_DD :
    SplitStep KDD 0 [[1], [1]] c3a (.ok (splitEff c3a 0 [[1], [1]])) ∧
    ¬ I1 (splitEff c3a 0 [[1], [1]]) := by
  refine ⟨.ok (by decide), fun h => ?_⟩
  have := h 1 2 ⟨.modify, some 0, [1], .frame 1, true⟩ ⟨.modify, some 0, [1], .frame 1, true⟩ 1
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) rfl rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  exact absurd this.1 (by decide)

/-- `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7) accepts the exit of a frame whose local is pinned without
`ExternalDone`, while `endUse` and `transfer` of that local are rejected (A8 lists `transfer`,
`free`, `endUse`, `unpin`, not `exitFrame`). -/
example : ExitStep (pinEff c13a 0 true) (.ok (exitEff (pinEff c13a 0 true))) := .ok (by decide)
example : EndUseStep K0 0 (pinEff c13a 0 true) .reject := .reject (by decide)

/-- A callee releases a root authority of its caller without holding any right on it: `release`
is not in the list of A2, and O3 has no right condition. -/
example : ReleaseStep 0 (enterEff c13a [] [(none, none, 0)])
    (.ok (releaseEff (enterEff c13a [] [(none, none, 0)]) 0)) := .ok (by decide)

/-- Reading of A2 ("mode effectif ≥" compared with the mode of the held authority): while a value
is shared in `Observe`, the root of its owned storage, a `Modify` authority held by the value,
cannot be exercised, even to read. Frame 1: 0 value, 1 owned storage. -/
example : Read3Step 1 [1] n6a (.ok n6a) := .ok (by decide)
example : Read3Step 1 [1] (deriveEff n6a 0 0 .observe) .reject := .reject (by decide)

/-- `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A5) does not preserve `Inv3` alone (A1): a part with another
owner than its parent (excluded by `WF3`) is not usable while its parent is; a place owned by
that part is not usable either and keeps an invalid anchor (5, which does not exist). The
transfer gives that place to the destination: it becomes usable with an invalid anchor. -/
theorem transfer_not_inv3_preserving :
    let s : S3 := ⟨[1, 0], 2, [⟨none, .frame 1, 0⟩, ⟨some 0, .frame 5, 0⟩, ⟨none, .place 1, 0⟩,
      ⟨none, .frame 1, 0⟩], fun l => if l = 1 then .init else .uninit,
      [⟨.modify, none, [1], .frame 1, true⟩, ⟨.modify, none, [3], .frame 1, true⟩],
      fun q => if q = 2 then [5] else [], fun _ => false, fun _ => false, fun _ => false⟩
    Inv3 s ∧ TransferStep K0 0 3 s (.ok (transferEff s 0 3)) ∧ ¬ I3 (transferEff s 0 3) := by
  intro s
  refine ⟨⟨fun a b x y p hab ha hb _ _ xp yp _ _ => ?_, fun b y a hb ho => ?_,
    fun q hq z hz => ?_, i4_always _⟩, .ok (by decide), fun h => ?_⟩
  · have h1 := lt_of_getElem? ha; have h2 := lt_of_getElem? hb
    simp [s] at h1 h2
    obtain rfl | rfl : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by omega
    all_goals obtain rfl | rfl : b = 0 ∨ b = 1 := by omega
    all_goals first | exact absurd rfl hab | (simp [s] at ha hb; subst ha hb; simp at xp yp; omega)
  · have := lt_of_getElem? hb; simp [s] at this
    obtain rfl | rfl : b = 0 ∨ b = 1 := by omega
    all_goals simp [s] at hb; subst hb; cases ho
  · cases Nat.decEq q 2 with
    | isTrue e => subst e; exact absurd hq (by decide)
    | isFalse e => simp [s, e] at hz
  · exact absurd (h 2 (by decide) 5 (by decide)) (by decide)

/-- With a duplicated frame on the stack (excluded by `WF3`), `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A4)
keeps active an authority held by the exited frame: the hypothesis `s.F.Nodup` of
`exitFrame_releases_all` is needed. -/
theorem exit_duplicate_frame :
    let s : S3 := { enter1 [(none, none, 0)] with F := [1, 1, 0] }
    ExitStep s (.ok (exitEff s)) ∧
      (exitEff s).A[0]? = some ⟨.modify, none, [0], .frame 1, true⟩ := by
  intro s; exact ⟨.ok (by decide), by decide⟩

/-- Adding an authority held by a holder that is not live breaks the possession clause of `WF3`
(A4): the hypothesis `HolderLive s hd` of `addAuth_preserves` is needed. -/
theorem addAuth_needs_live_holder :
    let s : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0)]
    WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ Allows (effective s 0 0) .observe ∧
      ¬ WF3 (s.addAuth ⟨.observe, some 0, [0], .frame 7, true⟩) := by
  intro s
  have h : WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s :=
    reachable_access_invariant_underDD (KT_dd [] [] [] [] []) (.enter .init (.ok (by decide)))
  refine ⟨h.1, h.2, by decide, fun h' => ?_⟩
  exact absurd (h'.poss 1 ⟨.observe, some 0, [0], .frame 7, true⟩ (by decide) rfl) (by decide)

/-- A frame exit leaves owned storage unreleased (A6, leak): the owned storage 1 of the box value
0 stops being usable at `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7) without `free`; nothing requires its
release. -/
example : ExitStep n6a (.ok (exitEff n6a)) := .ok (by decide)
example : ¬ (exitEff n6a).Usable 1 ∧ (exitEff n6a).freed 1 = false := by decide

/-- `free` after the end of the owner value is rejected (A6): the owned storage is dead. A
forgotten `free` cannot follow `endUse`. -/
example : FreeStep KF 1 7 (endUseEff n6a 0) .reject := .reject (by decide)

/-- An arena value cannot end while an issued block is live (A6, A10); once its blocks have ended,
it ends, and its storage is dead and not freed (leak). -/
example : EndUseStep KA 0 c6b.1 .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : EndUseStep KA 0 n10a (.ok (endUseEff n10a 0)) := .ok (by decide)
example : (endUseEff n10a 0).dead 1 = true ∧ (endUseEff n10a 0).freed 1 = false := by decide

end Ern.MM03

/-! ## Arène : instance du modèle (MM-03.3 §6, arbitrage 3)

L'empreinte de la valeur `arena` couvre ses seules métadonnées ; son autorité racine est
`anchor`. Le stockage administré est sous une autorité racine séparée `internal`. `issue` dérive
les blocs de `internal` et ancre la valeur qui reçoit le bloc sur l'autorité par laquelle
l'arène est atteinte. `reset` est gouverné par I3 (via `Invalidates`), jamais par I1. -/

/-- État logique de l'arène (MM-03.3 §6 : `Arena { anchor, storage, available, issued,
internal_authority }`) : `issued` associe chaque région émise à l'autorité émise. -/
structure Arena where
  anchor : Nat
  storage : List Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
  internal : Nat

/-- Invariant de l'arène (MM-03.3 §6). Clause 0, ajoutée : l'espace disponible fait partie du
stockage administré. Clauses 1 à 3 de MM-03.3 §6 : régions émises incluses dans le stockage
administré ; deux régions émises simultanément valides (autorités actives) disjointes ;
régions disponibles disjointes des régions encore distribuées. La clause 4 (accès distribués
dépendants de l'ancre de l'arène) n'est pas représentée : l'état ne relie pas une autorité à la
valeur qui la contient. La clause suivante, propre à l'abstraction, relie chaque émission à son
autorité dérivée de `internal`. Les dernières clauses traduisent l'arbitrage 3 : `internal` et
l'ancre sont deux autorités racines distinctes, le stockage administré est sous `internal`, et
l'empreinte de la valeur `arena` (celle de l'ancre) ne contient pas ce stockage. -/
def ArenaInv (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ ar.available, l ∈ ar.storage) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ ar.storage) ∧
  ar.issued.Pairwise (fun e e' => s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ ar.available) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some ar.internal ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify) ∧
  s.org ar.internal = none ∧ s.org ar.anchor = none ∧ ar.internal ≠ ar.anchor ∧
  (∀ l ∈ ar.storage, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ar.storage, l ∉ s.afp ar.anchor)

/-- Préconditions de `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6), dans l'ordre : la région est disponible ;
elle est disjointe des régions émises encore actives ; l'abstraction dispose, par `internal`, de
l'autorité effective de modification sur la région ; l'autorité `via` atteint l'arène (`anchor`
ou une dérivée) et peut modifier les métadonnées, par un mode effectif `Modify` ou, à défaut,
par `SharedMutable` (MM-03.3.8) ; la destination `dst` du bloc est encore utilisable
(MM-03.3.1), peut recevoir une valeur (sans feuille `Init`, comme pour O4.2) et respecte la
restriction de non-échappement envers `via` (MM-03.3.6). -/
def IssuePre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ ar.available) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ region, l ∉ e.1) ∧
  s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify) ∧
  s.Active via ∧ (via = ar.anchor ∨ ar.anchor ∈ s.ancs via) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ s.afp ar.anchor, effective s via l = some .modify ∨
    (effective s via l ≠ none ∧ k.SharedMutable l)) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ NoEscape s via (placeFrame s.P dst)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssuePre k s ar via region dst) := by
  unfold IssuePre NoEscape; infer_instance

/-- Effet de `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6) : retrait de `available` ; autorité exclusive
dérivée de `internal` sur la région, détenue par le cadre courant ; ajout à `issued` ; la valeur
reçue en `dst` est initialisée et ancrée sur `via` ; les régions déjà émises sont inchangées. -/
def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, s.top, true⟩ with
      I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init else s.I l
      D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ [via] else s.D q },
   { ar with
      available := ar.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })

/-- `arena.issue` comme relation (MM-03.3 §6). -/
def IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 (S3 × Arena) → Prop :=
  Guarded (IssuePre k s ar via region dst) (issueEff s ar via region dst)

/-- Préconditions de `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6 ; I3) : aucune autorité émise encore active ;
aucune valeur encore utilisable n'a une ancre que la réinitialisation invalide (`Invalidates`,
MM-03.3.8) ; aucune autorité active ne dérive de `internal` (§6 : « une région encore
effectivement utilisée ne peut être invalidée par `reset` »), ce qui couvre les dérivées d'une
émission rattachées à `internal` par `exitFrame`. Aucune condition d'exclusivité (arbitrage 3). -/
def ResetPre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Prop :=
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ¬ s.Active e.2) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, ¬ k.Invalidates s ar.anchor x) ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j)

instance (k : K) [∀ s r x, Decidable (k.Invalidates s r x)] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) :
    Decidable (ResetPre k s ar) := by
  unfold ResetPre; infer_instance

/-- Effet de `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6) : le stockage administré redevient disponible et les
anciennes émissions sont oubliées ; l'état `S3` est inchangé. -/
def resetEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : S3 × Arena :=
  (s, { ar with available := ar.storage, issued := [] })

/-- `arena.reset` comme relation (MM-03.3 §6). -/
def ResetStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (s : S3) : Outcome3 (S3 × Arena) → Prop :=
  Guarded (ResetPre k s ar) (resetEff s ar)

/-- Issue `ok` de `arena.issue` (MM-03.3 §6). -/
theorem issue_ok_iff {k : K} {ar ar' : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok (s', ar')) ↔
      IssuePre k s ar via region dst ∧ (s', ar') = issueEff s ar via region dst := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Issue `ok` de `arena.reset` (MM-03.3 §6). -/
theorem reset_ok_iff {k : K} {ar ar' : Arena} {s s' : S3} :
    ResetStep k ar s (.ok (s', ar')) ↔ ResetPre k s ar ∧ (s', ar') = resetEff s ar :=
  Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Une autorité active dérivée de `internal` couvrant `l` retire à `internal` l'autorité
effective de modification sur `l` : la disjonction d'une nouvelle émission avec les émissions
actives découle de la discipline d'accès (MM-03.3 §6). -/
theorem arena_issue_disjoint_of_authority {s : S3} {ar : Arena} {region : List Nat}
    (hwf : WF3 s) (hai : ArenaInv s ar)
    (hm : ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify) :
    ∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ region, l ∉ e.1 := by
  intro e he ha l hl hle
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hf, hmd⟩ := hai.2.2.2.2.1 e he
  obtain ⟨y', hy', ya⟩ := ha; rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
  have hlt := hwf.1 e.2 y ar.internal hy ho
  have hanc : ar.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2 := by
    unfold S3.ancs; rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, hy, ho]) hlt]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  have hd : Mode.modify ∈ descModes s ar.internal l :=
    mem_descModes.2 ⟨e.2, y, hy, ya, hf ▸ hle, hanc, hmd⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -, -, he'⟩ := effective_some (hm l hl)
  rcases effOf_cases he' with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, -⟩
  · simp [h0] at hd
  · exact hn hd

theorem org_addAuth_lt {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).org j = s.org j := by simp only [S3.org, addAuth_lt h]

theorem afp_addAuth_lt {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).afp j = s.afp j := by simp only [S3.afp, addAuth_lt h]

theorem active_addAuth_iff {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).Active x ↔ s.Active x := by

import Ern.MM03
open Ern.MM03

/-! T1: dependency of owned storage escapes the NoEscape check of transfer (O4.6, MM-03.3.6). -/

-- caller frame 1: place 0 (result), root 0; param 1 = Modify derived from 0.
-- callee frame 2: place 1 = v (frame-owned), place 2 = o (owned by v), place 3 = w (frame-owned)
-- roots: 2 (place 1, frame 2), 3 (place 2, held by place 1), 4 (place 3, frame 2)
def t1a : S3 := enterEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify) [1]
  [(none, none, 0), (none, some 1, 0), (none, none, 0)]
example : EnterStep [1] [(none, none, 0), (none, some 1, 0), (none, none, 0)]
  (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify) (.ok t1a) := .ok (by decide)
example : (t1a.A[4]?).map (·.origin) = some none := by decide
def t1b : S3 := dependEff (write3Eff t1a [1]) 2 4
example : Write3Step 2 [1] t1a (.ok (write3Eff t1a [1])) := .ok (by decide)
-- the owned storage o (place 2) depends on the root of callee local w (local anchor, no origin)
example : DependStep 2 4 (write3Eff t1a [1]) (.ok t1b) := .ok (by decide)
-- return v into the caller's result place 0: accepted, although the value (with its owned
-- storage, A5) depends on a local anchor of the callee
example : TransferStep K0 1 0 t1b (.ok (transferEff t1b 1 0)) := .ok (by decide)
-- the owned storage is now owned by the caller's place and keeps the callee-local anchor
example : (transferEff t1b 1 0).D 2 = [4] ∧ (transferEff t1b 1 0).pframe 2 = some 1 := by decide
-- rejection only happens at exitFrame
example : ExitStep (transferEff t1b 1 0) .reject := .reject (by decide)
-- ...and the callee can even drop the dependency first (endUse of the owned storage, via its
-- root now held by the caller's place), after which the exit is accepted.
def t1c : S3 := transferEff t1b 1 0
example : EndUseStep K0 2 t1c (.ok (endUseEff t1c 2)) := .ok (by decide)
example : ExitStep (endUseEff t1c 2) (.ok (exitEff (endUseEff t1c 2))) := .ok (by decide)

/-! Same scenario with o a PART of v instead of owned storage: transfer is rejected by NoEscape. -/
def t1p : S3 := enterEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify) [1]
  [(none, none, 0), (some 1, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
-- roots: 2 (place 1), 3 (place 3)
def t1q : S3 := dependEff (write3Eff t1p [2]) 2 3
example : Write3Step 2 [2] t1p (.ok (write3Eff t1p [2])) := .ok (by decide)
example : DependStep 2 3 (write3Eff t1p [2]) (.ok t1q) := .ok (by decide)
example : TransferStep K0 1 0 t1q .reject := .reject (by decide)

--        2 (place 4, frame 1), 3 (place 5, held by place 4)

  (some 1, some 0, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, some 4, 0)]
example : (t2a.A.map (·.holder)) = [.frame 1, .place 0, .frame 1, .place 4] := by decide
def ar2 : Arena := ⟨1, 1, [2, 3], []⟩
example : ArenaInv t2a ar2 :=
  ⟨(by decide), (by decide), (by decide), (by decide), fun _ h => (nomatch h), (by decide),
    ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩,
    fun _ => by rw [show t2a.afp ar2.internal = footprint t2a.P ar2.storage by decide]⟩

example : IssueStep KA ar2 0 [2] 5 t2a (.ok t2b.1 t2b.2) := .ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

import Ern.MM03
open Ern.MM03

/-! T4: `release` accepts the root of a value (not a temporary access, A6) in its own frame;
afterwards the value can neither end (`endUse`) nor have its owned storage freed (`free`). -/

-- n6a: frame 1, 0 box value (root 0, frame-held), 1 storage owned by 0 (root 1, held by place 0)
example : (n6a.A[0]?).map (·.origin) = some none := by decide
example : ReleaseStep 0 n6a (.ok (releaseEff n6a 0)) := .ok (by decide)
example : EndUseStep KF 0 (releaseEff n6a 0) .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : FreeStep KF 1 7 (releaseEff n6a 0) .reject := .reject (by decide)
-- the owned storage stays usable, its root stays active, nothing can exercise it
example : (releaseEff n6a 0).Usable 1 ∧ (releaseEff n6a 0).Active 1 ∧
    ¬ (releaseEff n6a 0).Exercisable 1 := by decide
-- whereas before the release, free then endUse were accepted (case n6)
example : FreeStep KF 1 7 n6a (.ok (freeEff n6a 1)) := .ok (by decide)

/-! T5: sanity: n6 sequence then frame exit (\"free en fin de cadre\"). -/
example : ExitStep (endUseEff (freeEff n6a 1) 0) .reject ∨
    ExitStep (endUseEff (freeEff n6a 1) 0) (.ok (exitEff (endUseEff (freeEff n6a 1) 0))) :=
  .inr (.ok (by decide))

It misses authorities that `cleanup` releases because their holder, the owned storage of p, dies. An active derived access can therefore outlive its released origin, which the report says is excluded.
findings.evidence: The report says: « Les descendants actifs des autorités libérées sont soumis à la même condition (O3.2) » ((c) 9). The correction table says: « un descendant actif d'une autorité désactivée doit être détenu dans p ou mourir avec lui ». The code only tests `∃ a ∈ s.ancs j, HeldWithin s p a`, and for free only `FreeDeact` (covers a leaf of p or is held within p), so a block held by a place that p owns is never examined. Witness file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/rev4/t2.lean (command `lake env lean`, exit=0, every example checked). Setup: `ArenaInv t2a ar2` holds; `issue` puts block 4 into place 5, which place 4 owns; the frame derives d = authority 5 (Modify) from block 4. Then `EndUseStep KA 4 t2c (.ok …)` is accepted. Afterwards `¬ Active 4 ∧ Active 5 ∧ org 5 = some 4`, and `Write3Step 5 [2] (endUseEff t2c 4) (.ok …)` still writes the arena region through d. In the same state, `ReleaseStep 4 t2c .reject` refuses to release the block directly. The free variant is in the same file: `FreeStep KF3 5 7 t3c (.ok …)` is accepted, and then `¬ Active 5 ∧ Active 6 ∧ org 6 = some 5`.

findings.claim: `transfer` checks anchor validity (O4.5) and non-escape (O4.6 / MM-03.3.6) only on `depsOf src`, that is src and its parts. Under A5 and report (j), owned storage is part of the composite value, but its dependencies are not checked. A value whose owned storage depends on a callee-local root anchor is accepted at transfer into a caller place, while the same dependency on a part is rejected. The report does not raise this in (c) or (e).
findings.evidence: MM-03.3.6: « Lorsqu'une valeur contient une autre valeur dépendante, la valeur contenante hérite des dépendances pertinentes » and « Une valeur dépendante ne peut être installée dans une destination dont le cadre survivrait à celui d'une ancre locale dont elle dépend. » Report (j): « Une valeur composite est un emplacement p avec : ses parties ; les emplacements qu'elle possède … ». But (j) also says « Les ancres de src et de ses parties … respectent NoEscape », and (b) says « Par l'héritage des valeurs contenues (depsOf) seulement, comme en passe 1 ».
